description: Build the authentication UI (sign up and login pages), phone OTP verification flow, and the user dashboard page showing profile/status info.
steps: Create src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx - Login page with email+password form. On submit, call signIn('credentials', {email, password}). Show error messages. Link to sign up page. Clean modern design with fitness theme (green/blue accents).

Create src/app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx - Sign up page with name, email, password, confirm password fields. On submit, POST to /api/auth/signup. On success, redirect to login. Validate passwords match client-side.

Create src/app/api/auth/signup/route.ts - POST endpoint that creates a new user. Hash password with bcryptjs. Store in users.json via db utility. Return error if email already exists. User object shape: {id, name, email, passwordHash, phone, phoneVerified, stravaConnected, stravaAccessToken, stravaRefreshToken, stravaAthleteId, createdAt}
Create src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx - A centered layout for auth pages with VitaVerse branding/logo at top

Create src/app/dashboard/page.tsx - Protected page (redirect to login if not authenticated). Show: user name, email, phone verification status (verified/not verified with link to verify), Strava connection status (connected/not connected with link to connect), list of active challenges with progress, list of earned verification QR codes. Use a card-based layout.
Create src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx - Dashboard layout with a top navigation bar showing VitaVerse logo, user name, and sign out button

Create src/app/dashboard/phone/page.tsx - Phone verification page. Step 1: form to enter phone number, submit sends POST to /api/otp/send. Step 2: form to enter 6-digit OTP code, submit sends POST to /api/otp/verify. Show success message when verified.

Create src/app/api/otp/send/route.ts - POST endpoint. Accepts {phone}. Generates random 6-digit OTP. Stores OTP in user record (with expiry timestamp, 5 min). Logs OTP to console (simulated SMS). Returns success.
Create src/app/api/otp/verify/route.ts - POST endpoint. Accepts {phone, otp}. Checks OTP matches and hasn't expired. If valid, sets user.phoneVerified=true, user.phone=phone. Returns success/failure.
Update src/app/page.tsx - Landing page with VitaVerse branding, brief description of the platform, and prominent Login/Sign Up buttons. If already logged in, redirect to dashboard.
Run npm run build to verify everything compiles
acceptance_criteria: Login page renders at /login with email and password fields
Sign up page renders at /signup with registration form
Dashboard page at /dashboard shows user status cards
Phone verification flow at /dashboard/phone has two-step OTP process
API endpoints exist: POST /api/auth/signup, POST /api/otp/send, POST /api/otp/verify
OTP is logged to console when 'sent'
findings: Build succeeds with all routes registered. useSearchParams() requires a Suspense boundary in Next.js 16 for static generation - wrapped LoginForm in Suspense component to fix this. All pages render correctly as static (dashboard, phone, login, signup) or dynamic (API routes, home page with session check). OTP is logged to console since no real SMS service is configured.
